items.prompt: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of a Hullbreaker, a massive alien predator from a cold heavy-gravity world. Four small glowing amber eyes sit in one straight row across the plated brow, with rows of small dark heat-sensing pits along the cheeks below them. A scrap armour harness of rusty hull plates and cables is strapped across the chest, hung with machine trophies: a cracked sensor lens, a torn circuit board, a bent antenna. The two jaw halves are closed, the split seam plain down the chin, a calm and patient menace.
